pr_title: Avoid throwing Win32Exception from HTTP authentication
pr_body:
When server sends malformed NTLM challenge the NT authentication processing would throw an unexpected `Win32Exception` from `HttpClientHandler.Send[Async]` calls. This aligns the behavior to WinHTTP handler where the Unauthorized reply with challenge token is returned back to the client.

Similarly, failure to validate the last MIC token in `Negotiate` scheme could result in `Win32Exception`. Handle it by throwing `HttpRequestException` instead. There's no test coverage for this at the moment since we cannot easily emulate successful authentication with broken MIC (yet).

Fixes #416.
